meaning: Only exact residual coverage failures from the prior policy remain eligible. Scores and failed flags stay unchanged; no false acceptance, execution error, or all-Arabic completeness is waived.
review_timing: Runtime identity migration only; no new waiver, gold, threshold or denominator changes.
scope: Register the licensed-workflow migration, source-derived scope and lexical-transmission surfaces. Packaged implementations/data remain unchanged except the discovery registry. Historical cases, questions, scorers, gold, denominators, thresholds and failure signatures are preserved. Tools, Lean and UI have separate execution identities. Registry coverage does not establish complete acquisition, intended meaning, source independence, tawatur or whole Arabic completeness.
